levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the seven portfolio sections is missing from the presentation or transcript.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All seven sections are presented or included in the transcript.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The presentation shows the sections connecting to each other as one coherent plan, not seven disconnected pieces.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than two genuine challenge questions are recorded, or the answers simply restate the plan without engaging the question.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least two genuine challenge questions are recorded with answers that actually engage the question.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: At least one answer shows real reasoning under challenge, including honestly acknowledging a limit or uncertainty where genuine.

lookFors: No audio or video recording exists anywhere for this task; only a written transcript or notes.
At least two distinct challenge questions and substantive answers are present.
A 'still deciding' or honestly limited answer to a challenge question is treated as acceptable, not penalized.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
